product.olivetti-lsx-5030.summary: The LSX 5000 that could share work across four 486 processors.
product.olivetti-lsx-5030.history: Olivetti offered the LSX 5000 line to medium-sized businesses and departments of large organisations under its OSA architecture. The 1992 brochure presented the 5030 as the multiprocessor server for departmental applications.
product.olivetti-lsx-5030.architecture: The processor bus was separate from the peripheral bus. OLIBUS4 links CPU and memory over 64 bits, and EISA handles I/O expansion.
product.olivetti-lsx-5030.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5030.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
